name: Calma
summary: Ambient sound and guided breathing in your notch
description:
Calma plays rain, waves, fire or brown noise from Droppy's shelf, and guides you through a few minutes of breathing when you need to slow down.

The sound is synthesised live, so it never loops. Start a session and the orb grows as you inhale and settles as you exhale, and the sound follows you: the waves roll in on the inhale and draw back on the exhale.

Pick Balance (5-5), Box (4-4-4-4) or Relax (4-7-8) in settings. Finish a session and the notch tells you so, with your streak.
